{"id":1953072554,"question_id":3492,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"4 months","timestamp":1773928855,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1953072554/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count Submatrices With Equal Frequency of X and Y","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int numberOfSubmatrices(vector<vector<char>>& grid) {\n        int n = grid.size();\n        int m = grid[0].size();\n\n        vector<vector<int>>new_grid(n , vector<int>(m , 0));\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = 0 ; j<m ; j++)\n            {\n                if(grid[i][j] == 'X') new_grid[i][j] = 1;\n                else if(grid[i][j] == 'Y') new_grid[i][j] = -1;\n                else new_grid[i][j] = 0; \n            }\n        }\n\n        vector<vector<int>>rowpref(n , vector<int>(m , 0));\n        vector<vector<int>>colpref(n , vector<int>(m , 0));\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++) rowpref[i][0] = new_grid[i][0];\n        for(int j = 0 ; j<m ; j++) colpref[0][j] = new_grid[0][j];\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = 1 ; j<m ; j++)\n            {\n                rowpref[i][j] = rowpref[i][j-1] + new_grid[i][j];\n            }\n        }\n\n        for(int j = 0 ; j<m ; j++)\n        {\n            for(int i = 1 ; i<n ; i++)\n            {\n                colpref[i][j] = colpref[i-1][j] + new_grid[i][j];\n            }\n        }\n\n        int ans = 0;\n\n        for(int k = 0 ; k < n; k++)\n        {\n            if(k == 0) continue;\n            if(new_grid[0][0] != 0 and colpref[k][0] == 0) ans++;\n        }\n        for(int k = 0 ; k < m; k++)\n        {\n            if(k == 0) continue;\n            if(new_grid[0][0] != 0 and rowpref[0][k] == 0) ans++;\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-submatrices-with-equal-frequency-of-x-and-y","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1849}
